title: Risky browser extensions in practice
intro: A useful extension can turn into a spy. Decide what you would do in each moment from this module's lessons.

decisions.title: Store page from a search
decisions.prompt: The first search result looks like the browser's extension store. What do you do?

artifact.title: Məzənnə Pro: free download
body: Məzənnə Pro shows exchange rates on every page. 4.9 stars, 1M+ users.

decisions.explain: This domain is not the store's own address. Open the store from the browser menu.

decisions.title: Tab that opened by itself
decisions.prompt: The browser opened this tab by itself. What do you do?

artifact.title: Congratulations! You won a phone
body: Claim your prize in the next 5 minutes.

decisions.explain: Tabs that open by themselves are often the work of a harmful extension. Close the tab and have your extensions checked.

decisions.title: Exchange rate extension permissions
decisions.prompt: Does showing exchange rates need these permissions?

artifact.title: Məzənnə Pro asks for access
body: Read and change all your data on all websites
See your tabs and browsing history

decisions.explain: If the permission does not fit the job, do not install it.

decisions.title: Screenshot extension permissions
decisions.prompt: Is it safe to install this extension?

artifact.title: Ekran Şəkli asks for access
body: See only the open page when you press the button
Save images to the Downloads folder

decisions.explain: The permissions fit the job and only work when you press the button. An extension like this adds no real risk.

decisions.title: Free VPN extension permissions
decisions.prompt: Is it safe to install this extension?

artifact.title: Pulsuz VPN Sürət asks for access
body: Read and change all your data on all websites

decisions.explain: A free VPN extension sees all your traffic and often earns its money from your data. For work, use only the VPN your office provides.
